y8kmc0pg.baseName: Walplus 300 LEDs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
y8kmc0pg.variantName: Walplus 300 LEDs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
y8kmc0pg.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree redefines seasonal decor with its sleek, cone-shaped form and warm LED lights that evoke a sense of modern elegance. Combining practicality with style, this seasonal must-have is perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to any space, whether indoors or out, making it a versatile centerpiece for homes and offices alike. Durable Materials: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree presents a lifelike appearance while ensuring durability and long-lasting use. The metal framework provides stability, supporting the tree's structure perfectly and maintaining its shape through multiple festive seasons. This combination of materials makes it both robust and visually appealing. USB Electric Connectivity: This tree includes a USB plug connection that conveniently powers the LED strip lights, eliminating the need for traditional power outlets. The easy plug-and-play setup enhances usability, allowing for effortless installation and repositioning within any space throughout the holiday season. Warm White LED Lights: A timeless choice for Christmas decorations, the LED strip lights emit a soft, warm glow to create an inviting atmosphere. These energy-efficient lights are not only visually stunning but also ensure consistent illumination without overheating, making them safe for daily use and family-friendly gatherings. Indoor and Outdoor Placement: This artificial tree is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering versatility in decoration locations. Its adaptable design allows it to grace living rooms, terraces, and gardens, providing festive charm in various environments with minimal maintenance. Care &Storage Tips: For optimal maintenance, cover the tree when not in use and store it in a dry, cool place after the holiday. Regular care ensures its vibrant appearance and functionality over years, allowing you to enjoy festive moments time and again without the hassle of annual tree purchases. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 48 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 368 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vmymfp1r.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Artificial Christmas Tree with 392 Branch Tips-Pink
vmymfp1r.sourceDescription: This stunning 6 ft Xmas tree dazzles with 392 pink flocked branch tips, creating a whimsical holiday centerpiece. Crafted from 100% new PVC, it is fireproof, anti-fading, non-allergic, and smell-free. Illuminate your celebrations with 140 warm white LED lights offering 8 enchanting lighting modes. The lighting modes include combination, in wave, sequential, slow fade, and beyond. Designed for stability, the 2-section Christmas tree’s foldable metal base features a built-in bolt for hassle-free setup and protective foot pads to protect your floors. Its slender pencil shape fits perfectly in tight spots, making it a versatile choice for home gatherings, festive parties, school events, carnivals, and more. Plus, it comes with gloves to ensure safe and effortless assembly. Note: Ornaments are not included. Best wishes for you! Eye-Catching Flocked Pink Branches: With 392 beautifully flocked pink branch tips, the 6 ft artificial Christmas tree creates a magical winter wonderland right in your home, radiating a cheerful and unique holiday spirit. High-Quality Material: Crafted from 100% new PVC, the Xmas tree is exceptionally fireproof and non-allergic, ensuring you can celebrate with complete peace of mind. The anti-fading structure keeps your tree looking stunning throughout the season. LED Lights for Festive Moods: Light up your holiday with 140 warm white LED lights offering 8 charming lighting modes. Easily switch between effects with the controller and enjoy safe, reliable operation thanks to the UL certified adaptor. Reliable Anti-Tipping Metal Base: You can count on outstanding stability with the folding metal base of the Xmas tree, featuring a preinstalled bolt that eliminates the hassle of misaligned holes. Protective foot pads safeguard your floors, so you can enjoy your holiday gatherings with confidence, style, and peace of mind. Slim Pencil Shape for Wide Use: The 2-section Christmas tree’s pencil shape is perfect for maximizing holiday cheer in even the coziest spaces, fitting perfectly in corners and narrow areas. Ideal for homes, offices, shops, and carnivals, this tree also comes with a pair of gloves for safe and comfortable assembly. vfhgh5ge.sourceDescription: Keep your Christmas tree secure and stable with this durable metal Christmas tree stand, designed for easy setup and convenient storage. Made from powder-coated iron, it offers resistance to rust, impact and wear, making it suitable for home and commercial displays. The four-corner support base features non-slip rubber pads to provide stability while helping protect floors from scratches. Three eye bolts help secure the tree trunk in position, and the tool-free assembly makes setup simple. When not in use, the stand folds completely flat for convenient, space-saving storage. Key Features: • Suitable for Christmas trees up to 7ft tall • Powder-coated iron construction for durability and resistance to rust, impact and wear • Four-corner support base provides reliable stability • Non-slip rubber pads help prevent movement and protect floors from scratches • Three eye bolts help secure the tree trunk in position • Suitable for tree trunks up to 2.5cm in diameter • Tool-free assembly for easy setup • Folds completely flat for convenient storage • Suitable for indoor home and commercial displays Specifications: • Product Type: Christmas tree stand • Material: Powder-coated iron • Maximum Tree Height: 7ft • Maximum Trunk Diameter: 2.5cm • Internal Hole Diameter: 2.5cm • Base Design: Four-corner support • Securing Mechanism: Three eye bolts • Base Protection: Non-slip rubber pads • Assembly: Tool-free • Storage: Foldable design. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
